Suppose you add a todo validation test and also tidy another test in the same file. You stage only the new test. A commit message describing both edits would promise a change that is not in the commit. Here is a reproducible example using its small JavaScript demo. You need Git, Node.js to run the demo tests, and an assistant that can read files and run Git commands. No npm dependencies are required. git clone https://github.com/zmo2s/agent-toolbox.git cd agent-toolbox git switch -c demo/partially-staged
